mapper.select: select c.id as wdp_id,c.wdp_name as wdp_name from sys_bussness_wdp a left join sys_role_doc_menu b on a.bussness_id=b.business_id left join sys_doc_menu_wdp c on c.id=a.wdp_id left join sys_user_role d on d.role_id=b.role_id where d.user_id=#{userId}
select id,business_name,parent_id,order_num from sys_doc_menu_business -- where is_check=0

select a.id as id,a.business_name as business_name,a.parent_id as parent_id,a.order_num as order_num from sys_doc_menu_business a left join sys_role_doc_menu b on a.id=b.business_id where b.role_id = #{role_id}

select a.id as id,a.business_name as business_name,a.parent_id as parent_id,a.order_num as order_num from sys_doc_menu_business a left join sys_role_doc_menu b on a.id=b.business_id where b.role_id = #{role_id}

select a.id as id,a.business_name as business_name,a.parent_id as parent_id,a.order_num as order_num from sys_doc_menu_business a where a.id in(select DISTINCT business_id from sys_role_doc_menu where role_id = #{role_id})

select a.operatetype as id, (case a.operatetype when 1 then '上传' when 2 then '下载' when 3 then '预览' when 4 then '分享' when 5 then '编辑' when 6 then '删除' else '其他' end) as business_name,a.business_id as parent_id,a.operatetype as order_num from sys_role_doc_menu a where a.role_id = #{role_id} and a.operatetype!=0
select operatetype from sys_role_doc_menu where business_id = #{business_id} and role_id = #{role_id}
select distinct business_id from sys_role_doc_menu where role_id = #{role_id}
